sources.source_status: Numerically solves stated conducting-fluid closure and gives selfsimilar scaling. Alpha2.190; core mass decreases with temperature in LMFP; transition to SMFP reduces mass loss.
sources.hypotheses: Isolated spherical classical elastic SIDM; Newtonian quasi-static fluid/conduction closure; LMFP selfsimilar envelope extends to infinity and has infinite mass. No action-produced quantum state or rotation.

sources.application: Conditional: decline of core mass applies within that closure. Alpha motivates our separately declared global slope cap; neither a finite envelope truncation nor universal global slope cap is proved by the paper.
